CustomField.description: Preset amounts for a numeric field that uses the Preset Amounts display type: quick-pick chips such as $25, $50 and $100. Edited in Form Builder's Edit Preset Amounts window and stored as JSON, for example {"enableCustomValues": true, "options": [{"label": "$25", "value": 25}]}. A free-entry input appears beside the chips when custom values are enabled, or when the saved value matches no chip.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Quick-pick amounts for a numeric field, managed from the Edit Preset Amounts editor in Form Builder. Each option pairs a label with the number it stores; enable custom values to always offer a free-entry input beside the chips.
CustomField.label: Number Presets
